tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Top trending topics for a niche. Returns title, source, niche, score, volume.

niche.description: Filter to a niche, e.g. AI, Crypto, Tech, Finance, Business, Health.

tools.name: virality_score
tools.description: Virality score + breakout probability + hook type for a topic or title.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Timing, momentum and lifecycle for a topic (rising vs peaking).

tools.name: opportunities
tools.description: Ranked opportunities for a niche, with possible monetization paths (estimates, not guarantees).

tools.name: prebreakout
tools.description: What's accelerating now, before it peaks — early-mover signal for a niche.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Daily what-to-post brief: phase-labeled pre-breakout alerts, measured outcome receipts, a validated pattern and the day's steepest mover. Drop-in replacement for a generic 'research trending topics' step in content pipelines.

tools.name: get_viral_patterns
tools.description: Validated viral patterns (hook / structure) confirmed over time — what's working now, with evidence.

tools.name: rescue_hooks
tools.description: Hooks for a topic, anchored in the title patterns currently validated across creators (live measured data, not a static list). Hook text is AI-drafted; the proof next to each hook (creators, days, strength) is measured. 5 credits.

topic.description: Your topic or working title (4-120 chars).

tools.name: grade_draft
tools.description: Grade a draft title/hook against the patterns currently validated in live data — this week's data, not a static rubric. Score math runs in code; every component states its basis (measured / ai_judged / rule). Includes up to 2 rewrites with measured proof. 5 credits.

draft.description: Your draft title or hook (4-200 chars).

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Freshest news stories, optionally for a topic.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Credits remaining + rate-limit status for your API key. Free (no credit cost).

tools.name: lolik_content_brain
tools.description: One-call content brief for a niche: what's trending, the best opportunities (with possible monetization), and timing. Combines several signals.

q.description: Optional specific topic to also forecast.
